chapter.heading: 1 John 1
The Word of Life
chapter.v: 1That which wasfrom the beginning,which we have heard,which we have seen with our eyes,which we looked upon andhave touched with our hands, concerning the word of life—
the lifewas made manifest, and we have seen it, andtestify to it and proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and was made manifest to us—
our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
that our joy may be complete.
God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.
the truth is not in us.
to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
his word is not in us.
